hints.title: Diagonal Index Sum Property
hints.text: Elements on the same diagonal have an identical sum of row and column indices (r + c).

hints.title: Grouping by Index Sum
hints.text: Collect elements into buckets indexed by r + c. For each diagonal, elements with larger row indices appear earlier.

hints.title: Iterate Buckets in Order
hints.text: Traverse the matrix row by row. Prepending or reversing elements in each diagonal bucket yields the desired order.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: total number of integers across all rows
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Direct grid traversal over max_row x max_col creates quadratic empty cell checks for jagged arrays.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Grouping only existing elements by r + c visits each element exactly once.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate groups elements by r + c key to handle jagged rows in linear time.
